facts.text: I've been feeling sick to my stomach.
These have all been getting worse.
I've been unsteady on my feet when I walk.
It's so bad that I can't stand up without help.

facts.item: how long the symptoms have been going on
facts.text: All of this started 10 days ago.
It started about 2 weeks after my first dose of the Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine.
I've had my first dose of the Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine.

aliases: weakness in an arm or leg
facts.text: I haven't noticed weakness in any part of my body.
I haven't had any breathing or chest symptoms.
I haven't been in contact with anyone known to have COVID-19.
I don't have any medical problems.

findings.name: cranial nerve examination
findings.result: Horizontal nystagmus to the left; dysarthria.

findings.name: gait and stance
findings.result: Marked truncal ataxia; unable to stand unassisted.

findings.name: brain MRI with and without contrast
findings.result: Bilateral hyperintense lesions in the cerebellar hemispheres, most prominent in the left middle cerebellar peduncle, with faint enhancement; no cervical spinal cord involvement.

findings.name: CSF analysis
findings.result: Protein 90 mg/dL; 10 white cells/mm3 with 80% lymphocytes.

findings.name: CSF PCR panel
findings.result: Positive for SARS-CoV-2; negative for varicella zoster virus, herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2, cytomegalovirus, and enterovirus.

gold.reasoning: 1. Multiple sclerosis was deemed unlikely because of absence of typical lesions and negative OCB — “The diagnosis of multiple sclerosis was unlikely due to the absence of multiple sclerosis‐like lesion in brain and oligoclonal bands in CSF.” 2. Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis and vascular lesions were excluded based on imaging findings — “The imaging studies were also negative for acute disseminated encephalomyelitis and vascular lesions.”

quotes.f006: 10 days of progressive nausea, slurred speech, and unsteady gait
quotes.f007: beginning approximately 2 weeks after her first dose of the Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine

f002: 'Progressive' stands before the whole list of presenting symptoms, so it is one standalone fact for all of them (harmonisation).
f005: Taken from the examination (s003): being unable to stand without help is something the patient notices.
f013: Blanket denial of a whole scope ('respiratory or chest symptoms'); answers only an open question about breathing or the chest. Specific chest symptoms stay unknown.

x001: 'Vital signs were normal' is split into one record per usual vital parameter; oxygen saturation is not assumed.

source_issues: CSF PCR positive for SARS-CoV-2 in a patient with no known COVID-19 contacts and no respiratory symptoms; the Sinopharm vaccine is inactivated and would not explain a positive PCR.
The cerebellar lesions are bilateral, while dysmetria is described only on the left.
notes: Index visit: the emergency presentation with 10 days of progressive nausea, slurred speech and unsteady gait (s001-s009 are this presentation and its workup).
The vaccine timing is a standalone fact (what came before the symptoms) plus a vaccination history fact; the PCR and CSF results are findings.
